about_the_game:
In this era ravaged by dragons, these mighty beasts are impervious to blades and arrows, capable of flight, and breathe fire—an almost unbeatable force against ordinary humans.

Humanity is on the brink of collapse. The kingdoms either strike shady deals with the dragons to survive or wage a desperate war against their invasion.

By a twist of fate, you are reborn as a Dragon Tamer, possessing an intense yang energy. If you can form intimate bonds with dragon maidens, you can "tame" them, turning them into powerful allies.

Whether you can break free from humanity’s fate of oppression and overthrow the existing order—it's all up to you, Dragon Tamer!

    Dragon Riders: Awakening of the Dragon Tamer" is a Roguelite + Top-Down Bullet Hell Shooter.

    In each stage, you must defeat waves of increasingly powerful enemies while leveling up and acquiring magic. At the 8-minute mark, you'll face the stage's final Boss.

    Even if you fail, you can strengthen your Dragon Maidens outside of battle, allowing you to return stronger and push forward!

◆ Talents

Spend gold to enhance base attributes, and even increase your starting level and the initial level of your Dragon Maiden's magic.

◆ Ultimate Arts

Defeat enemies to accumulate Ultimate Energy—once fully charged, unleash a devastating attack to sweep the battlefield.

◆ Fusion Magic

When two active spells reach their max level, they can be combined into a powerful Fusion Magic.

◆ Time Acceleration

When you've grown strong enough to dominate, activate Time Acceleration and crush everything in your path!

Black Dragon - Artanis, "The Weakest Black Dragon"

The frailest among dragons, Artanis has a reserved yet stubborn personality, unwilling to admit defeat. After being "picked up" in a dire state, she became the first Dragon Maiden to be tamed. Determined to become the strongest dragon, she embarks on a journey alongside the Dragon Tamer.

Red Dragon - Hephi, "The Wrathful Red Dragon"

Hot-tempered and impulsive, Hephi uses her fiery rage to mask her clumsy big-sister nature. She often struggles to tell whether others are joking or serious, making her an easy target for teasing. Despite her fierce exterior, deep down, she's a delicate and affectionate woman.

Yellow Dragon - Hadone, "The Unrestrained Yellow Dragon"

Carefree and uninhibited, Hadone lives purely for herself, embracing a life of indulgence. Seeking a man who can truly bring her pleasure, she has launched an invasion into the vast lands of the Federation. Little did the Federation government expect that this mighty dragon’s conquest was driven purely by desire for a worthy man.

Gray Dragon - Boseni, "The Necrotic Gray Dragon"

Boseni enjoys tormenting her prey, never letting go of those she fixates on. She will go to any lengths to achieve her goals—manipulation, obsession, even destruction in the name of "love".

Green Dragon - Floti, "The Hypocritical Saintly Dragon"

Floti loves to put on a facade of benevolence and compassion, but in truth, she delights in trampling humans beneath her feet and toying with men. A master manipulator, she has the high-ranking officials of the Holy Kingdom—even the Pope himself—wrapped around her finger.

content_descriptors.notes: All characters depicted are over the age of 20. Content Warning: The game contains violence , rape, bondage scenes,sadism and nakedness.

short_description: 拯救人類，征服龍女們的使命就交給你了~御龍者！《龍騎天下-御龍者覺醒》是一款 Roguelite + 俯視角清版射擊 的遊戲。以御龍者的力量支援最弱的黑龍少女，逐一討伐各國掌權的龍女們，並親自將她們＂馴化＂後，納入自己的龍之後宮吧！
